incidents.name: We are investigating reports of Teamwork Desk users unable to log in in our US region
incidents.message: During an alter to a large table, a database became unresponsive for a short time. A database replica was upgraded to handle the traffic which allowed Desk to recover.

incidents.name: We are investigating reports of errors appearing on screen in Teamwork in our US region
incidents.message: We have rolled back a deployment which was using up a little too much memory at peak traffic, triggering errors for some users in our US region.

incidents.name: We are investigating reports of slow response times from Teamwork in our US region
incidents.message: A small number of our database replicas in the US region were experiencing lag due to high usage, which has now been resolved.

incidents.name: We are investigating reports of users experiencing problems logging in, in our US region
incidents.message: Resolving this issue as we have not received any new reports of issues with logging in to our US region.

incidents.name: we are investigating reports of issues with Teamwork Desk in our EU region
incidents.message: Teamwork Desk in our EU region remains stable and we will monitor for any issues

incidents.name: Warnings when visiting teamwork.com sites using Google Chrome.
incidents.message: We continue to go through the apps and find any issues. As of right now Helpdocs, Customer portal, and Desk all look good.

incidents.name: We are investigating reports of users being logged out of Teamwork Chat in our US region
incidents.message: We experienced a few moment of lag connecting to our main sessions Redis cache. This has now passed and logins are working as normal.

incidents.name: Teamwork Desk 2 US region emergency maintenance
incidents.message: This issue is now resolved, the database changes have been stable for a number of hours.
